multiScaleAC Result Object

Source: R/classes.R
kernelcomm_result-class.Rd

S4 class for storing multi-scale Moran's I results.

Slots

h

Numeric vector of bandwidths

observed

Numeric vector of observed Moran's I values

permutations

Numeric matrix (n_h x n_perms) of permuted values. May have zero columns when the result was computed with perms = 0.

coords

Matrix of original coordinates (for plotting)

gene1_name

Character. Name of gene 1

gene2_name

Character. Name of gene 2

sample_id

Character. Sample identifier

seed

Numeric. Random seed used

n_cells

Integer. Number of cells

call

Language. Function call that created this object

p_values

Numeric vector of p-values

z_scores

Numeric vector of standardised effect sizes. These are effect sizes only; see compute_significance for why converting them to p-values with pnorm() is unsound for this statistic.

perm_mean

Numeric vector, mean of the permutation distribution

perm_sd

Numeric vector, standard deviation of the permutation distribution

null_lower

Numeric vector, lower bound of the null envelope. This is a quantile of the permutation distribution, describing where the statistic would fall under complete spatial randomness. It is not a confidence interval for the observed value, which is what the former name ci_lower wrongly implied.

null_upper

Numeric vector, upper bound of the null envelope

significant

Logical vector, p below the chosen threshold

p_adjusted

Numeric vector, p-values after multiple-testing correction

sup_statistic

Numeric scalar, whole-curve supremum statistic

sup_p_value

Numeric scalar, p-value for the whole curve

moment_var

Numeric vector, exact variance of the permutation null. Exact, not estimated: see multiScaleAC.

moment_skewness

Numeric vector, exact skewness of the permutation null

moment_excess_kurtosis

Numeric vector, exact excess kurtosis of the permutation null

leverage

Numeric vector, largest single cell's share of the null variance. Values near 1 mean one cell dominates and no continuous approximation to the null can be trusted at that bandwidth.

moment_cov

Matrix, exact cross-bandwidth covariance of the null

p_method

Character vector recording which method produced each p-value

Uncomputed slots

Optional slots are zero-length vectors until computed, not NA. So length(x@p_values) == 0 means "not computed", which is distinguishable from a computed-but-missing value.
